mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS above 4.5%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 4% and PAYEMS increases by > 200k in a month, signaling a strong labor market, S&P 500 forward returns are positively affected over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO, indicating improved industrial production, enhances productivity and efficiency, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during non-recessionary periods.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window during non-recession periods, or SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of such periods with positive INDPRO growth.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in HOUST, signaling strengthened housing demand, positively influences S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, but only when RSAFS is above its 6-month moving average.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always, a low CPIAUCSL reading (< 220) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as it indicates subdued inflation pressures.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window, or SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of instances with CPIAUCSL below 220.

mechanism_narrative: When PAYEMS decreases by > 100k in a month, signaling labor market weakness, S&P 500 forward returns are negatively affected over the next 20 trading days, but only during monetary tightening cycles.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when GDPC1 and RSAFS both increase in the same quarter, signaling broad demand strength, S&P 500 forward returns are positively influenced over the next 60 trading days, but only in non-recessionary periods.
regime_hint: non-recessionary growth with broad demand strength
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window during non-recession periods, or SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of such periods with joint GDPC1 and RSAFS growth.
